title: User Login
description: Allows users to log in to the system using their credentials. Provides options for new users to sign up and for existing users to reset their password.

steps.value: The user navigates to the application's login page.
The user enters their registered email or username and password into the respective fields.
The user clicks the 'Login' button.
If login is successful:
subitems: If the user has a single role, they are redirected to their default landing page (e.g., Patient Dashboard, Doctor Dashboard, Admin Dashboard).
If the user has multiple roles, they are presented with a 'roleSelection' view to choose their role for the current session.

steps.value: If login fails due to incorrect credentials, an error message is displayed.
The user can click 'Sign Up' to create a new account (leads to signup scenario).
The user can click 'Forgot Password' to initiate the password reset process (leads to forgotPassword scenario).

title: User Sign Up
description: Enables new users to register for an account, providing their details and selecting an appropriate role (e.g., patient).

steps.value: The user navigates to the 'Sign Up' page, typically from the login page.
The user provides required personal information such as first name, last name, email address, and sets a password.
The user selects their desired role from a dropdown list. (For initial signup, this would typically be 'patient' as 'admin' and 'none' are restricted).
The user agrees to terms and conditions/privacy policy (if applicable).
The user clicks the 'Register' or 'Sign Up' button.
The system sends a verification email to the provided address.
The user is redirected to a confirmation page, instructing them to check their email for a verification link.

title: Forgot Password
description: Allows users to request a password reset link if they have forgotten their password.

steps.value: The user navigates to the 'Forgot Password' page, typically from the login page.
The user enters their registered email address.
The user clicks the 'Submit' or 'Reset Password' button.
The system sends a password reset link to the provided email address.
The user is redirected to a confirmation page, instructing them to check their email for the reset link.

title: Reset Password
description: Enables a user to set a new password after receiving a password reset link via email.

steps.value: The user receives an email with a password reset link and clicks on it.
The user is directed to the 'Reset Password' page, where the reset token is typically pre-filled or embedded in the URL.
The user enters a new password and confirms it by re-entering it.
The user clicks the 'Set New Password' or 'Reset' button.
If the password reset is successful, the user is notified and typically redirected to the login page to sign in with their new password.
If the reset token is invalid or expired, an error message is displayed, and the user may be prompted to request a new reset link.

title: Admin Dashboard Overview
description: Provides administrators with a central overview of key hospital operations, quick access to management modules, and system health indicators.

steps.value: Login leads to Admin Dashboard scenario. If the administrator has multiple roles, they select 'admin' role from the role selection screen.
The administrator views a summary of system status, such as active users, pending appointments, and system alerts.
The administrator can navigate to User Management, Appointment Management, Reporting, Hospital Settings, or Audit Logs modules using a navigation menu or dashboard widgets.

title: Manage User Accounts
description: Allows administrators to create, view, modify, and deactivate user accounts for both patients and doctors, and assign roles.

steps.value: The administrator navigates to the User Management module from the Admin Dashboard.
The administrator views a list of all registered users (patients, doctors, and other administrators).
The administrator can search and filter users by various criteria (e.g., role, status, name, email).
The administrator can select a user to view their profile details.
The administrator can create a new user account, providing necessary details and assigning one or more roles (e.g., patient, doctor, admin).
The administrator can edit an existing user's profile, including updating personal information, contact details, and modifying assigned roles.
The administrator can deactivate or reactivate a user account.

title: Oversee All Appointments
description: Enables administrators to view, filter, and manage all appointment activities across the hospital, resolve conflicts, and monitor scheduling efficiency.

steps.value: The administrator navigates to the Appointment Management module from the Admin Dashboard.
The administrator views a comprehensive list of all appointments (upcoming, past, cancelled, pending) across all doctors and patients.
The administrator can filter appointments by doctor, patient, date range, status, and specialty.
The administrator can view detailed information for a specific appointment.
The administrator can modify an appointment's status (e.g., confirm, cancel, reschedule) or details.
The administrator can identify and resolve potential scheduling conflicts.

title: Generate Operational Reports
description: Allows administrators to generate configurable reports and dashboards on appointment activity, user engagement, and communication metrics, with options to export data.

steps.value: The administrator navigates to the Reporting & Analytics Dashboard from the Admin Dashboard.
The administrator selects a report type (e.g., appointment trends, user activity, doctor utilization, communication metrics).
The administrator defines report parameters and filters (e.g., date range, specific doctor/patient, status filters, data aggregation level).
The administrator generates and views the report or dashboard, which displays data visually (charts, tables).
The administrator can export the report data in CSV or PDF format.

title: Manage Hospital Configuration
description: Enables administrators to manage and update hospital-wide configurable settings, including operating hours, holiday schedules, and general operational policies.

steps.value: The administrator navigates to the Hospital Settings Configuration module from the Admin Dashboard.
The administrator views current hospital settings, such as operating hours, defined holidays, and system-wide policy documents.
The administrator can edit existing settings, such as modifying operating hours or holiday dates.
The administrator can add new settings or upload new policy documents.
The administrator saves the changes to the hospital settings.

title: View Protected Health Information (PHI) Access Audit Logs
description: Allows administrators to review immutable audit logs of all access to Protected Health Information (PHI) for compliance purposes.

steps.value: The administrator navigates to the Audit Log Viewer module (inferred from 'PHI Access Audit Logging' functional requirement).
The administrator views a chronological list of PHI access events.
The administrator can filter audit logs by user, date/time range, patient, type of access (e.g., read, update), and data accessed.
The administrator can view detailed information for each audit entry, including who accessed what, when, and from which source.
The administrator can export audit log data for compliance reporting or further analysis.

title: Patient Dashboard Overview
description: Provides patients with a personalized overview of their health information, including upcoming appointments, recent medical records, and quick access to profile management and messaging.

steps.value: Login leads to Patient Dashboard scenario. If the patient has multiple roles, they select 'patient' role from the role selection screen.
The patient views a summary of their upcoming appointments.
The patient sees a summary of recent medical records or visit summaries.
The patient can quickly access options to manage their profile, schedule appointments, view medical records, or send messages to their doctor.

title: Manage Patient Profile
description: Allows patients to securely update their personal information, contact details, and other profile-related data.

steps.value: The patient navigates to the 'Profile Management' section, typically from the Patient Dashboard or a navigation menu.
The patient views their current personal information, such as name, date of birth, contact details, and emergency contacts.
The patient can edit fields like address, phone number, email, and emergency contact information.
The patient saves the updated profile information.
The system confirms the successful update.

title: Schedule New Appointment
description: Enables patients to book new medical appointments with available doctors, respecting doctor availability.

steps.value: The patient navigates to the 'Schedule Appointment' section, typically from the Patient Dashboard or a navigation menu.
The patient selects a specialty or a specific doctor.
The patient selects a preferred date range or specific date for the appointment.
The system displays available time slots based on doctor availability and selected criteria.
The patient chooses an available time slot.
The patient provides a reason for the appointment.
The patient reviews the appointment details and confirms the booking.
The system confirms the appointment and provides a confirmation message.

title: View and Manage Appointments
description: Allows patients to view their upcoming and past appointments, and cancel existing appointments.

steps.value: The patient navigates to the 'My Appointments' section, typically from the Patient Dashboard or a navigation menu.
The patient views a list of their upcoming appointments, including date, time, doctor, and reason.
The patient can filter or sort appointments (e.g., by upcoming, past, cancelled).
The patient selects an upcoming appointment to view its details.
From the appointment details, the patient can choose to cancel the appointment.
The patient confirms the cancellation.
The system updates the appointment status and provides a confirmation message.

title: Access Medical Records
description: Enables patients to securely view their medical records and visit summaries, ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations.

steps.value: The patient navigates to the 'Medical Records' section, typically from the Patient Dashboard or a navigation menu.
The patient views a list of their medical records or visit summaries, sorted chronologically.
The patient can filter or search for specific records (e.g., by date, doctor, type of visit).
The patient selects a specific record to view its detailed content, including diagnoses, treatments, and notes.
The patient can download or print the medical record if the option is available.

title: Secure Patient-Doctor Messaging
description: Provides a secure, encrypted, and auditable messaging channel for confidential communication between patients and their assigned doctors.

steps.value: The patient navigates to the 'Secure Messaging' section, typically from the Patient Dashboard or a navigation menu.
The patient views a list of their ongoing conversations with doctors.
The patient can start a new conversation by selecting a doctor from a list of their assigned doctors.
The patient types their message into a text input field.
The patient clicks 'Send' to transmit the message.
The patient can view the conversation history and any replies from the doctor.

title: Manage Consent Preferences
description: Allows patients to manage their consent preferences for data usage and privacy policies, and exercise their rights for data access, correction, or deletion.

steps.value: The patient navigates to the 'Consent Management' or 'Privacy Settings' section, typically from their profile or a dedicated menu item.
The patient views a list of consent types (e.g., data sharing, marketing communications, research participation).
For each consent type, the patient can see their current preference (granted/denied).
The patient can modify their consent preferences by toggling options or selecting choices.
The patient can initiate a request for data access, correction, or deletion through a dedicated form or button.
The patient reviews and confirms their updated consent preferences or data request.
The system confirms the successful update or submission of the request.

title: Doctor Dashboard Overview
description: Provides doctors with a central hub to manage their schedule, access patient EHRs, track appointment requests, and communicate with patients.

steps.value: Login leads to Doctor Dashboard scenario. If the doctor has multiple roles, they select 'doctor' role from the role selection screen.
The doctor views a summary of their upcoming appointments.
The doctor sees a summary of pending appointment requests.
The doctor views recent messages from patients.
The doctor can navigate to Schedule Management, Patient EHRs, Appointment Requests, or Secure Messaging modules using a navigation menu or dashboard widgets.

title: Manage Clinical Schedule
description: Allows doctors to define their availability, set working hours, and view their daily/weekly schedules.

steps.value: The doctor navigates to the 'Schedule Management' module from the Doctor Dashboard.
The doctor views their current calendar, showing scheduled appointments and blocked times.
The doctor can set or modify their working hours for specific days or a range of dates.
The doctor can block out specific time slots for personal reasons or unavailability.
The doctor can view their schedule in daily, weekly, or monthly formats.

title: View and Update Patient Electronic Health Records (EHR)
description: Enables doctors to securely access and update the Electronic Health Records of their assigned patients, including adding notes, diagnoses, and treatment plans.

steps.value: The doctor navigates to the 'Patient EHR' module from the Doctor Dashboard or selects a patient from an appointment.
The doctor searches for a specific patient or selects one from a list of their assigned patients.
The doctor views the patient's comprehensive medical record, including past visits, diagnoses, treatments, and lab results.
The doctor can add new notes, diagnoses, or treatment plans to the patient's EHR.
The doctor can update existing entries in the patient's EHR.
The doctor saves the changes to the patient's EHR.
The system confirms the successful update and potentially triggers external EHR synchronization.

title: Track and Respond to Patient Appointment Requests
description: Allows doctors to review and act upon pending appointment requests from patients, including approving or declining them.

steps.value: The doctor navigates to the 'Appointment Requests' module from the Doctor Dashboard.
The doctor views a list of pending appointment requests from patients.
For each request, the doctor can view details such as patient name, requested date/time, and reason for visit.
The doctor can choose to approve the appointment request, confirming the time slot.
The doctor can choose to decline the appointment request, optionally providing a reason or suggesting alternative times.
The system sends a notification to the patient regarding the doctor's decision.

title: Secure Doctor-Patient Messaging
description: Provides a secure, encrypted, and auditable messaging channel for confidential communication between doctors and their assigned patients.

steps.value: The doctor navigates to the 'Secure Messaging' module from the Doctor Dashboard.
The doctor views a list of their ongoing conversations with patients.
The doctor can start a new conversation by selecting a patient from their assigned patient list.
The doctor types their message into a text input field.
The doctor can attach relevant files or medical records to the message (if applicable).
The doctor clicks 'Send' to transmit the message.
The doctor can view the conversation history and any replies from the patient.

title: Select Application Role
description: Allows an authenticated user who has been assigned multiple application roles (e.g., patient, doctor) to select which role they want to operate under for the current session.

steps.value: Login leads to Role Selection scenario if the authenticated user has been assigned multiple application roles.
The user is presented with a list of their assigned application roles (e.g., 'Patient', 'Doctor').
The user selects one of the available roles.
Upon selection, the user is redirected to the landing page specific to the chosen role (e.g., Patient Dashboard, Doctor Dashboard).
